acceptanceCriteria: Subcommands are enumerated from the command tree, not only the declared tables.
Documented subcommands missing from source are reported.
Refusal codes match owned error-code declarations exactly.
Focused tests cover all three and fail before the fix.
body: Residual from lane cem-1022r (PR beamfall/corvint#1550, seal dbc8920d4). After CAP-V0-007..009: subcommands absent from the declared tables (for example flows coverage, flows record) are never checked; subcommands removed from source but still listed in docs/CAPABILITIES.md are not flagged; a refusal code counts as present if any string literal anywhere contains the same word.
title: capabilities-check misses undeclared subcommands, stale documented subcommands and substring-matched refusal codes
